events.title: Alpha Demo OUT NOW Early!
events.summary: Robovival Alpha Demo is out EARLY NOW! Everyone is now able to download it free and test it if they wish.I Decided to go ahead and push the demo out earlier than expected. There was no need for me to sit on the Demo until the 6th or 7th of October. I already had a select few test out the Demo and they were pleasantly surprised at how well it ran for being just an Alpha demo.Robovival will still be Participating in the Steam Next Fest.Have fun with the demo and Let me know any feedback in the Com

events.title: RoboVival Updating Enemy ANT Sounds
events.summary: Just an update on the Robovival game, Enemy Ants now have different Sounds.Updated / added the idle, on hit, attack and defeat sounds.

events.title: RoboVival Updating UI & Hud
events.summary: Just an update on the Robovival game UI and Hud.I redid the UI, HUD and Menus, but didn't mess with the layout.I also added the character Hud bars underneath the Stats Menu in your inventory and got rid of some Text.I changed Buttons, Font, Hovered and Selected Colors.Inventory / Hotbar Squares and Frames have been changed to a more sci fi look.Note: that you can Enable / Disable parts of the HUD / UI how you want.

events.title: Added a new Harvest Feature! Thanks to Reddit!
events.summary: I posted a video on Reddit and got some Feedback. One idea stood out so I decided to Implement it. The idea was simple enough.Someone basically asked for some more variety when harvesting the furniture.I made some crates that now have a chance to spawn a TINY ANT or TINY ROBO BEETLE when you destroy the crate.
